title: Micro-model prospector playbook and onboarding cost scenario lab
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: High-level plan: build a repeatable playbook for tracking emergent small-context/micro models (<=6B) that are attractive for low-latency RAG and on-device scenarios. Deliver a signal taxonomy, cost-onboarding scenarios (hosted vs dedicated vs private), and a lightweight scoring surface for PM/Eng to prioritize model ingestion and fallback readiness. Research will combine telemetry, public release signals, vendor pricing, quantization support notes, and internal evals.
data_sources: enterprise RFP snippets collected by sales
signal_taxonomy: stability: release cadence and variant proliferation
methodology: Phase 1: passive harvest (2 weeks) — crawl model manifests, pricing pages, and community signals; Phase 2: targeted field probes (3 weeks) — pick top 12 candidates and run synthetic RAG workloads across hosted/dedicated/private configurations; Phase 3: synthesis and playbook (1 week) — produce final scoring and onboarding thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published with step-by-step ingestion checklist
Drive scoring sheet populated with >=12 candidate models and scoring for all taxonomy dimensions
Bench results for p50/p95/p99 latency on a canonical RAG workload across hosted and dedicated recorded in dashboard mock
Clear decision rules for 'onboard', 'monitor', 'decline' with cost delta estimates
comments: 2025-02-18 - Kickoff: scoped by PM Aisha — aim to unblock SRE and sales by providing actionable onboarding thresholds. Linked GH repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/micromodel-prospector (WIP).

2025-02-19 - Eng sync: Leo and Mei from EngRTC to provide telemetry schema. Agreed to prioritize p99 and memory footprint for micro models. Trade-off: micromodels often lack optimized kernels; quantization may be necessary to meet latency SLOs, but introduces quality risk.

2025-02-19 - Research note: pulled initial candidate list from HF nightly feeds — ~36 new micro-models in last 30 days. Flagged 9 with permissive licenses. Spreadsheet draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE.
2025-02-20 - PM decision: focus on models that support int8 or better quant pipelines; exclude models with opaque licensing. Assigned field probes to Eng (ENG-5221) for workload runs.

2025-02-20 - Design input requested: ask UX to draft a compact dashboard card showing model score, cost delta (hosted vs dedicated), and roll-forward risk. Link to design brief: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MDL/Micromodel+Prospector+Brief
notes: Trade-offs to document: bandwidth of model variants (many forks), reproducibility of tokenizer implementations, vendor pricing cadence. Proposed weekly check-ins with SRE and Sales Ops during field probes.
